pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"none from the state for surf lessons in most places; each instructor holds a current lifeguard or first-aid card the business says is current; where a city or park permits commercial lessons on its beach, the permit is the business's own word, shown only once the owner says it is on file","who":"the business, for its registration and any beach permit; each instructor, for their own lifeguard or first-aid card","ask":"the business registration; any beach permit, with the beaches and dates it covers; each instructor's card and its end date","check":"Rosie checks no card, license or permit: each one is the business's own word, shown as that, never as a state license or as checked","scope":"an instructor is offered only for the beaches and lesson types the owner says they may teach","blocks":"goes live on identity and the business's registration; an instructor is offered once the owner says yes","renewals":"cards reminded 30 and 7 days before; a card the owner reports lapsed takes that instructor off new lessons","insurance":"liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it is sent","background":"background checks for instructors who teach children, where the rules ask: the business's own word"}
pluginText.pf.services: {"shape":"class: seats in a scheduled lesson on the beach, each surfer with their own spot and their own code; a private lesson books one instructor for one person or a family; at a customer's place (flow B) the instructor goes to the beach the group picks","examples":"the example school's own prices (Lee Surf School and Lee Surf Lessons), not a standard","list":[{"name":"Group beginner lesson (90 min, board and wetsuit lent)","price":"$85 a person","kind":"one price per person","length":"90 minutes","where":"at the beach stand (flow A)","before":"paid in full when booking","after":"nothing more","capacity":"8 surfers per instructor; runs with 3"},{"name":"Private lesson (60 min, one instructor)","price":"$140","kind":"one price","length":"60 minutes","where":"at the beach stand (flow A)","before":"a card saved for the $40 fee, paid at the beach stand","after":"at the stand, the rest is paid","capacity":"one or two people, one instructor"},{"name":"Kids group lesson (ages 8 to 12, a parent on the sand)","price":"$70 a child","kind":"one price per child","length":"60 minutes","where":"at the beach stand (flow A)","before":"paid in full when booking","after":"nothing more","note":"a parent or guardian books and signs; children under 8 need a parent on the sand"},{"name":"Paddle board session (90 min)","price":"$60","kind":"one price","length":"90 minutes","where":"at the beach stand (flow A)","before":"paid in full when booking","after":"nothing more"},{"name":"Private lesson at a rental house or hotel (up to 4 people)","price":"$160","kind":"one price per group","length":"90 minutes","where":"at the customer's place, then the beach they pick (flow B)","before":"a card saved for the $40 fee","after":"the saved card charged when the instructor texts DONE"},{"name":"Beach party lesson (up to 6 people)","price":"$420","kind":"one price per group","length":"90 minutes","where":"at a beach the customer picks, where the city allows lessons (flow B)","before":"paid in full when booking","after":"nothing more","note":"the beach permit where it asks for one, booked ahead; big surf: a new time or a full refund"}],"intro":"the free beach look: nothing is taken; it's an instructor's talk on the sand before any lesson, booked by text","capacity":"spots per lesson set by the instructor's limit (8 surfers per instructor); a second instructor adds spots","minimum":"a group lesson runs with 3, counted 24 hours before; too few: Sam runs it or cancels, and each surfer gets a full refund or another time","waitlist":"a full lesson keeps a waitlist; a freed spot goes by text to one person at a time","skills":"surf and paddle lessons, kids' lessons, private lessons, beach permits by beach","online":"no","nobodyHome":"never: the surfer must be there"}
pluginText.pf.questions: {"beforeTimes":["which lesson, and the date","how many surfers, and their ages (children's lessons are for ages 8 to 12)","has the surfer tried surfing or paddling before (sets the level and the group)","for a lesson at a customer's place: the address, the beach they want and the area"],"afterTime":["board and wetsuit sizes, to lend","anything the instructor should know: a fear of the water, a health need, a language"],"securePage":["each surfer's name, age and a waiver, read and signed","health notes: heart, asthma, a seizure or a recent surgery, and any medicine they carry","a swimming level the instructor should know","an emergency contact","for a child: the parent or guardian's OK and who may pick them up"],"whoMayBook":"an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child under 18 (children 8 to 12 in group lessons; teens 13 to 17 with a guardian's OK); children under 8 are booked with a parent on the sand","told":"the beach, the meeting point, the length, that surf conditions decide the day, and what to bring"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"someone not breathing or unresponsive in the water right now, or a child who can't get a breath","say":"Call 911 now. Start rescue breathing or CPR, and call for the lifeguard.","booking":"no booking"}],"goOn":[{"words":"a heart condition, asthma, a recent surgery, or pregnancy","what":"the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the instructor reads it before the lesson; Rosie gives no health advice"},{"words":"a surfer afraid of the water","what":"the booking goes on; the instructor starts on the sand, and nobody is pushed into the water"}],"inWater":"a surfer swallows water or is in trouble: the instructor lifts them out and checks breathing; 911 for trouble breathing; the instructor's first-aid steps follow; Sam is told","always":"the generic screen, always on"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"steps":[{"name":"Waiver on the secure page","when":"while booking","who":"every surfer; a parent or guardian signs for a child","result":"not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked"},{"name":"Health questions on the secure page","when":"before the first lesson","who":"every surfer","result":"the booking goes on; any yes is read by the instructor before the lesson, on the secure page"},{"name":"Surf conditions check","when":"by 7am the day of the lesson","who":"the instructor, then Sam","result":"unsafe surf: the lesson is called off, and the customer picks a new time or a full refund"}],"prep":"a swimsuit, sunscreen, water and a rash guard; arrive 15 minutes early for the board and wetsuit; a photo ID for the first lesson"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"the instructor ticks each surfer at the beach stand, or takes each surfer's own code","lateEntry":"a late surfer joins until 10 minutes after the start; after that the spot may go to someone waiting, and the lesson ends on time","changes":"an extra hour or a private add-on is priced first, and the surfer says yes; nothing is added to a group lesson","leaveEarly":"a surfer who leaves early pays the full price: the spot was theirs","done":"the instructor texts DONE at the end of the lesson"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"a group lesson, a kids' lesson and a paddle session paid in full when booking; a private lesson at the beach: a card saved for the $40 fee, paid at the beach stand; a lesson at a customer's place: a card saved for the $40 fee, charged when the instructor texts DONE; a beach party paid in full","after":"everything is settled before, or at DONE on the saved card; nothing is billed later","cancel":"free to cancel or move up to 24 hours before (the school's setting); later, or a no-show, the price may be kept only with the owner's yes","fees":"late cancel or no-show: the $40 fee on a private lesson, the price on a group; the owner confirms each fee; no answer in 24 hours means no fee","makeups":"when the school calls a lesson off for surf or weather: a full refund or another time, never a fee","caps":"deposits within the state's limits where they apply","tips":"no tips line","tax":"any sales tax the state requires, in the price before the yes","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many surfers"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"health notes, injuries, a child's name and age in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page","staffTexts":"the instructor's day list shows the lesson and the number of surfers; names open on the secure page","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"texts go to the parent or guardian who booked"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each instructor's lifeguard or first-aid card, the business's own word, never checked by Rosie","skills":"surf and paddle lessons, kids' lessons, private lessons; the beaches each instructor knows; children's lessons only with instructors the owner says may teach children","ratio":"up to 8 surfers per instructor; children's lessons at 4 per instructor","standIn":"another instructor who knows the beach and the lesson; a private customer who named an instructor is asked first, and nobody moves on silence","oks":"Sam OKs beach parties, private add-ons and refunds"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"showFacts":"the beach, the meeting point, the length, that surf decides the day, and the cancel terms before the yes; any beach permit the city asks for","cancelRight":"no cancel period for a lesson already given","waiver":"what a waiver may say, where the state limits it; the state form sets the words","minors":"children with a parent or guardian on the booking; a child is never left with staff without the parent's OK on file","records":"waivers and health notes kept with the booking for 7 years, or longer where the state asks","reviews":"a rating once after the lesson"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"surf":"high surf, a red-flag day or lightning: the instructor or Sam calls the lesson off by 7am the day of, or at the beach; a full refund or another time, the customer picks","tooFew":"too few by 24 hours before: Sam runs it or cancels; each surfer gets a full refund or another time","late":"a late surfer joins until 10 minutes after the start; after that the spot goes to someone waiting","instructorOut":"another certified instructor covers the same lesson at the same time","childLeaves":"a child leaves the group: the instructor keeps the rest together, calls the parent at once, and only a listed adult takes the child","unwell":"a surfer looks unwell: the instructor stops the lesson, gives first aid, calls 911 if it's serious, and Sam is told; nothing about it goes in a text","minors":"a child is picked up by a listed adult; a teen (13 to 17) may leave only when the guardian's OK says so","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}

ops.label: Something required is missing
ops.why: A swim diaper is sold at the front desk and the waiver is signed while booking, so nothing missing stops a lesson.

ops.label: A finding stops the work
ops.why: A swimmer hurt or unwell is 'Someone is hurt or feels sick' (A8-38).

ops.label: A drop-off
ops.why: Nothing is left at the school.

ops.label: Insurance pays part
ops.why: A swim school bills no insurance.

ops.label: No: named-only work
ops.why: Trial lessons, group lessons and private lessons are rated.

ops.label: Next visit booked at checkout
ops.why: After a trial, a child's next lesson comes with starting a monthly session (A10-x02). An adult books the next private lesson like any booking.

ops.label: The business sends a proposal
ops.why: The school sends no proposals: the session's terms are on the note page, and starting one is the parent's own choice.

ops.label: An item isn't picked up
ops.why: Nothing is left at the school for work.

ops.label: By video or phone
ops.why: Every swim lesson is in the water, so none is ever by video or phone.
